name: Kavita
description: Self-hosted manga, comics, and ebook reader — browse series, track reading progress
author: Crow

env_vars.name: KAVITA_USERNAME
env_vars.description: Kavita username for API authentication (Crow creates `admin` at install and writes it here)

env_vars.name: KAVITA_PASSWORD
env_vars.description: Kavita password for API authentication. Crow generates it at install and keeps it in Settings → Passwords.

notes: Crow registers Kavita's first account (`admin`) itself at install and saves the password in Settings → Passwords, so the registration page is never left open for anything else on the machine to claim. Port 5000 is commonly used — set KAVITA_PORT in docker-compose.yml if needed.
